test_title: PYST 31: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 3 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: The writer found the online course useful because he ______.

options.text: could adjust and fit the course to his work schedule
did not have to submit regular assignments
was given special study leave from his executive duties
spent wonderful hours chatting online about his interests

solution:
The correct answer is **"could adjust and fit the course to his work schedule".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• "The writer found the online course useful because he could adjust and fit the course to his work schedule" is the correct statement according the **first paragraph of the passage. **In the first paragraph of the passage it is clearly stated that Online courses offer students **greater control over their own learning by enabling them to work at their own pace.** So option 1 is correct.
 
• All other options except option 1 is not clearly mentioned in passage.

So, the correct answer is **"option 1".**
